description: This file contains functions, types, and constants related to managing execution approval workflows, including creating approval states, resolving decisions, handling approval requests, and generating user messages within a shell or automation context.

methods.name: rememberExecApprovalFollowupFailureKey
methods.description: Tracks approval follow-up failures to limit memory growth, returns true if the failure is new.

methods.name: createExecApprovalPendingState
methods.description: Creates a pending approval state with warnings and expiration time.

methods.name: createExecApprovalRequestState
methods.description: Creates an approval request state including notice seconds.

methods.name: createExecApprovalRequestContext
methods.description: Generates a new approval request context with unique ID and slug.

methods.name: createDefaultExecApprovalRequestContext
methods.description: Creates a default approval request context with preset timeout.

methods.name: resolveBaseExecApprovalDecision
methods.description: Determines approval outcome based on decision, fallback, and obfuscation.

methods.name: resolveExecHostApprovalContext
methods.description: Resolves approval context for a host, considering security and ask policies.

methods.name: resolveApprovalDecisionOrUndefined
methods.description: Attempts to resolve an approval decision, calls onFailure on error.

methods.name: resolveExecApprovalUnavailableState
methods.description: Determines if approval is unavailable based on source and decision.

methods.name: createAndRegisterDefaultExecApprovalRequest
methods.description: Creates and registers a default approval request, resolving its state.

methods.name: buildDefaultExecApprovalRequestArgs
methods.description: Builds argument object for default approval request.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalFollowupTarget
methods.description: Constructs a follow-up target object for approval.

methods.name: createExecApprovalDecisionState
methods.description: Creates a decision state based on user input and obfuscation detection.

methods.name: shouldResolveExecApprovalUnavailableInline
methods.description: Determines if approval unavailability should be resolved inline based on trigger and reason.

methods.name: buildHeadlessExecApprovalDeniedMessage
methods.description: Generates a denial message for headless execution scenarios.

methods.name: sendExecApprovalFollowupResult
methods.description: Sends follow-up result for an approval, logs failures.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalPendingToolResult
methods.description: Builds a tool result object indicating approval pending or unavailable status.
